I'm not familiar with TeXMaker, but I believe the bottom line is you
can separate compilation from editing, i.e., you may well use TeXMaker
to edit your Rnw file, and just use command line to compile the
document, e.g. knitr::knit() in R, pdflatex/latexmk, etc
